arch.h: How this page will be kept
arch.p: After the edition, the record keeps only what Vigie produced: label, counts, times, links. Publisher texts disappear from our archives.
brand.name: Vigie
chip.auto.model: Grouped automatically · measured precision: {p}% over {n} pairs (95% interval: {lo} to {hi}%), pairs labelled by a language model, none checked by a person.
chip.auto.unrecorded: Grouped automatically · measured precision: {p}% over {n} pairs (95% interval: {lo} to {hi}%), labelling origin not documented.
chip.certain: Certain grouping · precision measured on pairs checked by people: {p}% over {n} pairs (95% lower bound: {lo}%).
chip.probable: Probable grouping · precision measured on pairs checked by people: {p}% over {n} pairs (95% interval: {lo} to {hi}%).
cover.note: This permanent record keeps no publisher text: only who, when, in what language, with what link.
ed.empty: No event in this edition. An absence from our feeds is not absolute silence.
ed.lede: {events} · {institutions} · collected at {tm}. One page; the order follows the rule published in the method.
ed.lede.fallback: {events} · {institutions} · collected at {tm}. One page; the published ranking rule could not be applied: fallback order, newest first.
ed.notbuilt: This collection’s events could not be established: no card is shown rather than an inaccurate one. Records from earlier collections remain available.
ed.river: The full brief: every article of the collection (in French) →
first.tip: Earliest time declared in the publishers’ feeds
foot.text: Vigie is free, ad-free, account-free and tracker-free, forever. Texts belong to their publishers; every card links to the source.
jr.note: Vigie’s collection times (Eastern time). A record is never closed: it only stops taking articles outside Vigie’s window.
k.label: Label
lang.chip.both: coverage in French and in English
merged.p: This record was merged into another at the collection of {d}: its articles are shown there together. This address stays published as long as the record that gathers them is.
merged.p.nodate: This record was merged into another: its articles are shown there together. This address stays published as long as the record that gathers them is.
meta.desc.event.merged: {label}: record merged into another Vigie record. No publisher text.
meta.desc.event.perm: {label}: permanent Vigie record (label, counts, times, links, seal). No publisher text.
meta.desc.home: Québec City events as reported by the media and the authorities: grouped, timed, compared. Free, ad-free, no account.
mine.nojs: This feature needs JavaScript: matching happens on your device. Without it, browse the events and obstructions below.
mine.p: Type a street or neighbourhood. Matching happens on this device, word for word; nothing is sent, no account.
neigh.p: Close by a word or a thread, but judged different. Vigie prefers under-grouping to a wrong merge.
neigh.reason.same_thread: Same thread, another episode. A thread is not an event.
neigh.reason.shared_word: Shares a word with this event, but Vigie judges it different.
nums.p: Side by side, as published. Vigie does not conclude there is a disagreement.
off.cap.one: {n} of {total} shown, in the order of the rule: first the releases dated within the {h} hours before the collection, those the method places in Québec City, then in Quebec, then elsewhere; within each group, by publication date, newest first.
off.cap.other: {n} of {total} shown, in the order of the rule: first the releases dated within the {h} hours before the collection, those the method places in Québec City, then in Quebec, then elsewhere; within each group, by publication date, newest first.
off.empty: No official release outside the events above in this collection.
off.fill.one: Too few releases are dated within the last {h} hours to fill the list: {n} older release, or one without an established date, completes it and is marked as such.
off.fill.other: Too few releases are dated within the last {h} hours to fill the list: {n} older releases, or without an established date, complete it and are marked as such.
off.groups: Breakdown of the {total}: {fresh} dated within the last {h} hours (Québec City {city} · Quebec {province} · elsewhere {other}) · {older} older or without an established date.
off.sub: Official releases, as published. None is linked to an event above.
offlink.none: None found among the City of Québec, the Government of Québec and Hydro-Québec.
offlink.none.in: None found among the official records followed: {insts}.
offlink.none.nosrc: None: no official source is followed.
offlink.note: A link to an official record is not a confirmation.
orig.note: Counting articles does not count independence. The ownership shown describes a structure (legal form, shareholder), as each source's public reference states it; never a judgement on an outlet.
orig.note.link: Each source, its public reference and the date it was read →
orig.same: {a} and {b} have the same owner ({g}): they count as a single origin.
rank.decided.fresh: Set apart from the event before it by: freshness.
rank.decided.geo: Set apart from the event before it by: geographic scope.
rank.decided.id: Tied with the event before it on all four criteria; set apart by its identifier, a fixed order.
rank.decided.now: Set apart from the event before it by: what affects daily life right now.
rank.decided.origins: Set apart from the event before it by: the number of independent reporting origins.
rank.fallback: Fallback order: newest first (last article: {t}). The published ranking rule could not be applied to this edition.
rank.fresh: Latest article {h} h ago; more recent than {pct}% of this edition's events.
rank.fresh.unknown: No usable publication or collection time: ranked after the dated events.
rank.geo.linked: Scope: wider (a linked story, outside Quebec City and the province).
rank.geo.quebec-city.anchor: Scope: Quebec City (established by an official declaration of the City linked to this event).
rank.hidden.below_median: Not shown: below this edition's median ({n} events compared).
rank.hidden.no_member: Not shown: no article of this event can be shown any more.
rank.hidden.over_cap: Not shown: at or above the median, but beyond the first {cap}.
rank.now.active: Affects daily life right now: {n} official obstruction(s) in force, linked to this event.
rank.now.none: No official obstruction, alert or outage in force is linked to this event.
rank.now.outage: Official outage linked to this event ({n}), covered for under 24 h.
rank.now.soon: Affects daily life within 24 h: {n} official obstruction(s) starting within 24 h, linked to this event.
rank.now.unknown: The reference time is unknown: this criterion could not be evaluated.
rank.origins: Independent reporting origins: {n} ({d} official declaration(s), not counted as origins). More than {pct}% of this edition's events.
rank.shown: Shown: at or above this edition's median ({n} events compared), within the first {cap}.
rank.summary: {shown} events shown out of {total}: {below} below this edition's median, {over} beyond the limit of {cap}.
roads.age: A snapshot, not a live feed: these declarations are as old as the collection time shown, and the real state may have changed since. The official map prevails.
roads.all: Open the Before you leave screen →
roads.attr: City of Québec, real-time traffic obstructions, via Données Québec (CC-BY 4.0).
roads.nodata: No declaration received in the latest collection. Check the official map before you leave.
roads.none: No obstruction declared in this collection. That does not mean no work is taking place on the network.
roads.shown.one: The most restrictive one is shown.
roads.skew: Inconsistent timestamp: the collection time shown is later than this page’s clock, so its age cannot be established. Check the official map before you leave.
roads.stale: Collection due for a refresh: these declarations are more than six hours old. Check the official map before you leave.
roads.sub: Obstructions as declared and published, most restrictive first. Source: {inst}.
roads.total.one: {n} obstruction declared, {c} with all lanes closed
roads.total.other: {n} obstructions declared, {c} with all lanes closed
roads.withdrawn: Source withdrawn at its publisher’s request (public takedown register): no obstruction is reproduced here.
roads.withheld: The takedown register could not be read: as a precaution, no obstruction is reproduced here.
roster.declared.one: {n} release collected, none linked to an event
roster.declared.other: {n} releases collected, none linked to an event
roster.declared_shown.one: {n} release collected, none in an event shown
roster.declared_shown.other: {n} releases collected, none in an event shown
roster.h: Who spoke, who published nothing in our feeds — measured at this collection
roster.outside.one: {n} article collected, none in a displayed event
roster.outside.other: {n} articles collected, none in a displayed event
rule.official: Declared by the authorities: the collection’s official releases that no card shown contains or cites as an official record; first those dated within the {h} hours before the collection (the event window), those the method places in Québec City, then in Quebec, then elsewhere; within each group, by publication date, newest first; at most {n}. An older release, or one without an established date, appears only when fewer than {n} remain inside the window, and is marked as such.
rule.pages: Record rule: a record exists for every event of the current collection, and for a past event covered by at least two institutions or tied to an official record; at most {n}: first the events shown, then the rest of the current collection in ranking order, then past events, newest first. Publisher texts appear on it only during the current collection.
rules.1.p: Every headline is reproduced as published, with its author and language. Vigie translates nothing.
rules.2.p: What links articles is spelled out: shared words, time gap, confidence level.
rules.3.p: Who published nothing in our feeds on a subject is recorded as such, not erased. No outlet is rated.
seal.ev: Sealed in the Registre, edition no.
seal.tail: The seal contains no publisher text.
sil.collection_gap: our collection failed: absence not established
sil.p: Institutions followed with no article linked to this event in this collection.
single.text: Only one voice reported this among the {n} institutions followed. That is a recorded fact, not a gap.
single.text.plain: Only one voice reported this in this collection. That is a recorded fact, not a gap.
site.name: Vigie
tl.legend: Times as declared by publishers in their feeds (Eastern time). Tap a dot to jump to the article.
tl.legend.static: Times as declared by publishers in their feeds (Eastern time).
voice.text_gone: Text outside this collection: Vigie keeps no copy. The link leads to the original.
voices.notranslate: Vigie does not translate: each voice stays in its own language.
why.label: Vigie’s addition
why.label.none: only the links (no type is established for this event); everything else is copied.
why.label.text: only the “{k}” label and the links; everything else is copied.
why.lead.first: the first published (declared time); the others are in the record.
why.lead.lang: the first published in the interface language; other languages are in the record.
why.level.auto: Grouped automatically by a published rule; no person checked this grouping. An automatic rule can be wrong: Vigie prefers to under-group.
why.level.certain: Certain — fixed rule, checkable by hand.
why.level.numbers: The measured quality of the groupings is published as figures:
why.level.possible: Possible — close by a word or a thread, but not grouped.
why.level.probable: Probable — French/English pairing by shared anchors. An automatic rule can be wrong; Vigie prefers under-grouping.
why.voices.single: a single article, a single organization
window.out: This event has left Vigie’s window: no more articles are added to it. That says nothing about how it turned out.
words.p: Tap a word to highlight it in the texts. “≙” marks a known alias between two forms.
